items.html: The third aspect is that their illumination is further drawn downward, into the NHY of Ima, and there it enters into their inwardness and is clothed within them. The fourth aspect is that there their illumination sparkles outward, in the secret of surrounding light, in the manner mentioned above. And this surrounding light is the main existence of the essential surrounding light of ZA within him, and it stands here above, outside the NHY of Ima; and from here it is the aspect of surrounding light for the head of ZA.
